================================================================================
                    GITHUB SECRETS QUICK SETUP CHECKLIST
================================================================================

Repository: https://github.com/07sharmasantosh2004-hub/Localkart
Last Updated: 2024-01-20

================================================================================
                        WHERE TO ADD SECRETS
================================================================================

Go to: https://github.com/07sharmasantosh2004-hub/Localkart/settings/secrets/actions

Click: "New repository secret" for each item below

================================================================================
                     5 REQUIRED SECRETS TO ADD
================================================================================

[ ] SECRET #1: KEYSTORE_PASSWORD
    Name:  KEYSTORE_PASSWORD
    Value: [Your keystore password]
    Type:  Secret

    Example: MySecure@Keystore#Pass2024
    This is the password you used when creating release.keystore

================================================================================

[ ] SECRET #2: KEYSTORE_ALIAS
    Name:  KEYSTORE_ALIAS
    Value: localkart-key
    Type:  Secret

    Note: This is fixed, do NOT change

================================================================================

[ ] SECRET #3: KEYSTORE_ALIAS_PASSWORD
    Name:  KEYSTORE_ALIAS_PASSWORD
    Value: [Your key password]
    Type:  Secret

    Example: MySecure@Keystore#Pass2024
    Usually same as KEYSTORE_PASSWORD

================================================================================

[ ] SECRET #4: ANDROID_KEYSTORE_B64
    Name:  ANDROID_KEYSTORE_B64
    Value: [Base64 encoded release.keystore file]
    Type:  Secret

    HOW TO GET:

    On Mac/Linux:
    $ base64 release.keystore | tr -d '\n' | pbcopy

    On Windows PowerShell:
    $ $keystore = [Convert]::ToBase64String([IO.File]::ReadAllBytes("release.keystore"))
    $ $keystore | Set-Clipboard

    Then paste into GitHub secret

================================================================================

[ ] SECRET #5: PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT
    Name:  PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT
    Value: [Entire Google Play service account JSON]
    Type:  Secret

    HOW TO GET:
    1. Go to https://console.cloud.google.com
    2. Create service account: "localkart-github"
    3. Grant role: Editor
    4. Create JSON key
    5. Download JSON file
    6. Copy ENTIRE content and paste here

================================================================================
                         OPTIONAL VARIABLES
================================================================================

You can also add these as "Variables" (not Secrets) if you want:

Go to: https://github.com/07sharmasantosh2004-hub/Localkart/settings/variables/actions

[ ] VARIABLE #1: APP_VERSION
    Name:  APP_VERSION
    Value: 1.0.0
    Type:  Variable

[ ] VARIABLE #2: ANDROID_PACKAGE_NAME
    Name:  ANDROID_PACKAGE_NAME
    Value: com.localkart.app
    Type:  Variable

[ ] VARIABLE #3: PLAY_STORE_TRACK
    Name:  PLAY_STORE_TRACK
    Value: internal
    Type:  Variable

================================================================================
                          VERIFICATION STEPS
================================================================================

After adding all secrets:

1. Go to: https://github.com/07sharmasantosh2004-hub/Localkart/settings/secrets/actions

2. You should see all 5 secrets listed:
   ✓ KEYSTORE_PASSWORD
   ✓ KEYSTORE_ALIAS
   ✓ KEYSTORE_ALIAS_PASSWORD
   ✓ ANDROID_KEYSTORE_B64
   ✓ PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT

3. Test CI/CD:
   $ git commit --allow-empty -m "test: trigger CI/CD"
   $ git push origin main

4. Go to Actions tab and verify build workflow runs successfully

================================================================================
                            SECURITY NOTES
================================================================================

✅ DO:
  - Use strong passwords (25+ characters)
  - Keep passwords in password manager
  - Keep keystore locally (never commit to git)
  - Rotate secrets periodically
  - Audit access logs

❌ DON'T:
  - Commit .env or keystore files to git
  - Share secrets via chat or email
  - Use weak passwords
  - Hardcode secrets anywhere
  - Write secrets in commit messages

================================================================================
                        TROUBLESHOOTING
================================================================================

Build fails with "Keystore not found":
  → Check ANDROID_KEYSTORE_B64 is proper base64 encoding
  → Regenerate base64 if needed

Build fails with "Invalid keystore password":
  → Verify KEYSTORE_PASSWORD is exact match
  → Check for extra spaces
  → Ensure special characters are correct

Build fails with "Play Store authentication error":
  → Verify PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT JSON is valid
  → Check service account has Play Store API access
  → Confirm service account hasn't been deleted

================================================================================
                           NEXT STEPS
================================================================================

1. ✅ Create release.keystore file (if you don't have one)
   cd frontend/android
   keytool -genkey -v -keystore release.keystore \
     -keyalg RSA -keysize 2048 -validity 10000 \
     -alias localkart-key

2. ✅ Get keystore passwords and save securely

3. ✅ Create Google Play service account and download JSON

4. ✅ Add all 5 secrets to GitHub

5. ✅ Verify secrets are visible in GitHub

6. ✅ Test CI/CD pipeline by pushing a commit

7. ✅ Monitor build logs in Actions tab

8. ✅ Fix any errors and retry

9. ✅ Deploy to Play Store when ready!
